name: LocalTry AI CRM
tagline: Run and customize a tenant-isolated CRM from your AI assistant
description: A remote OAuth-secured MCP server for operating a LocalTry business workspace. Manage customers, leads, jobs, schedules, estimates, invoices, reviews, documents, marketing, workflows, and tenant-owned workspace pages without exposing another business's data. A dedicated LocalTry ChatGPT plugin is coming soon.

install.notes: Cline opens LocalTry's OAuth flow during connection. Sign in with the LocalTry account whose workspace you want to operate; access is bound to that tenant.
